findings.current: a great weight had settled in his chest
findings.defect: The source specifically describes a large boulder resting on one corner of Jin Taekyung’s heart. The translation drops the boulder image and changes the location to his chest, also losing a detail preserved in the accepted baseline.
findings.rationale: The Korean says 커다란 바윗덩어리가 얹혀 있었다 (a large boulder was placed/resting there) and locates it in one corner of his heart.
findings.replacement: a massive boulder was already weighing down one corner of Jin Taekyung’s heart

findings.current: He pushed the ominous question from his mind. Right now, keeping his attention on the enemy was all he could manage.
findings.defect: The assembled English repeats that Jin forced the ominous question from his mind; the source states this only once, then says that focusing on the enemy was already more than enough for him.
findings.rationale: Line 97 already renders 애써 지워 냈다 (forced himself to erase it). Lines 98–99 add only that focusing on the enemy was all he could manage.
findings.replacement: Right now, keeping his attention on the enemy was all he could manage.

findings.defect: The source says the Demon Lord spoke to everyone present, then corrects himself: no, to the Emperor. The assembled English omits the first audience, so the correction loses its contrast.
findings.rationale: The Korean explicitly gives both targets in sequence: 이 자리의 모두를 향해. 아니, 황제를 향해.
findings.replacement:
To everyone gathered there.

No—to the Emperor.

summary: The assembled English is mostly faithful, but it drops a source image, repeats a thought, and omits who the Demon Lord first addresses.
